content: We have simulated a combined topology with 6 resistors: R1,R2 from subnet1 (both between A and X1), and R3,R4,R5,R6 from subnet2 (B to N_b3, N_b3 to N_b2, N_b2 to N_b1, N_b1 to X1). The simulated resistances match the measurements given: A-B 56.667, A-X1 6.667, A-N_b1 11.667, etc. We should verify other measurements to ensure full match. Let's test a few more: A-N_b2, A-N_b3, B-X1, B-N_b1, etc.
